Native UX comparison · Round 4 / review 1

Unmodified Linux Qt screen captures with pinned R 4.6.1. Click a frame to inspect its full resolution. Historical before frames retain their original provenance; the start-page after frame is pristine, while the palette pair below includes controlled recent projects.

D4-04 · Start in the main window

Create, import or open directly; the worksheet appears when an outcome exists.

D4-05 · Read the result first

Pooled result, heterogeneity, test and prediction interval precede model configuration and calculation details.

D4-05 · One caption per clinical result

Repeated section/table captions are removed from the report, copied text and table selector.

Finding 2 / D4-07 · Diagnostic forest, three decimals

Measured header leading, round probability ticks and a separate axis-title baseline.

Findings 1 and 3 · BMJ binary forest, six decimals

Pooled label clears totals; conventional overall-test wording clears the first tick and footer.

Finding 4 / D4-06 · Calculator controls

Compact confidence wording and consistent native actions, with the existing estimate and interval unchanged.

D4-07 · Keep reference guides within the evidence rows

The default forest null guide stops at the studies, leaving the pooled estimate and inference footer clear.

Finding 3 / D4-07 · Name the displayed clinical quantity

A logit analysis displays Proportion and names the actual tested null: proportion = 0.5.

D4-04 / D4-06 · Recent projects and native palettes

Full paths wrap; missing files remain visible and unavailable. The same controls follow the native light and dark palettes.

D4-06 · Clear navigation

Choose outcomes, follow-ups or groups, then use Previous / Next / Add. Existing operations and tooltips remain.
